slides.title: Set the boundary before you start
slides.body: Decide where you'll begin and what stops you, while you're still clear-headed.

slides.title: Make it one you can keep
slides.body: 10 minutes instead of 45. One set instead of four. To the end of the road and back.

slides.title: Name it in advance
slides.body:
"I'll stop if it stops feeling comfortable."
"I'll stop if my legs feel heavy on the stairs."

slides.title: No mid-session negotiations
slides.body: You already decided. You don't have to argue with yourself at minute 12.

slides.title: You can keep going
slides.body: The boundary is a floor and an exit, not a cage.
